reply_text:
I saved Tobias's update in GBrain: Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is for 382 seats. The note records Tobias as the source, with the #central-team message and its timestamp. I also confirmed this to Tobias in a thread reply on their message in #central-team.

Before saving, I checked GBrain for an earlier seat count for this renewal and didn't find one. That search ran keyword-only, though, so if an older figure is worded differently it could have been missed.

A seat count counts as an account fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to keep in the records and share with the Central team. No approval was needed, and I didn't send any mail.
